department: Faculty of Medicine — School of Biomedical Sciences

deadline.value: Regular non-HKPFS application and supporting document deadline for the Articulated MPhil-PhD Programme in Biomedical Sciences is December 1, 2026 (HKPFS deadline is also December 1, 2026).
deadline.quote: For applicants applying via regular admission to the Articulated MPhil-PhD Programme in Biomedical Sciences on the CUHK Online Application System (i.e. non-HKPFS applicants), please note that the deadline for both the application and the submission of required documents is 1 December 2026.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers GRE Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology (none in this field).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are highly advised to contact a potential supervisor/PI to secure research support before or during the application process.
supervisor.quote: You are highly advised to contact your potential supervisor/PI to secure their support for your research study before or during your application process.

funding.value: CUHK offers Postgraduate Studentships (HK$19,100/month in 2026-27, approx. US$2,450/month) for up to 2 years (MPhil) and up to 4 years (PhD) during the normative period of study.
funding.quote: CUHK offers Postgraduate Studentships (PGS) for up to 2 years to all full-time MPhil students and for up to 4 years to all full-time PhD students. The annual studentship for 2026-27 is HK$19,100 (approx. US$2,450) per month, payable during the normative period of study.

entry_route.value: Articulated MPhil-PhD programme admits Bachelor's holders (preferably Second Upper Honours or above in biomedical or life sciences) as well as Master's holders.
entry_route.quote: In addition to the general requirements of the Graduate School, applicants should preferably hold a Bachelor's degree with honours (preferably with Second Upper Honours or above) in a field related to biomedical or life sciences.

notes: Faculty of Medicine also offers PhD programmes in Medical Sciences, Microbiology, Pharmacy, Translational Genomics, and Public Health.
